alloy.preparation: Model M1 alloy from NRIM, Japan; vacuum induction melted/cast, hot rolled under controlled atmosphere then cold rolled to 2.154 mm sheet. Solution annealed at 1150 °C for 20 min and water quenched. Cu-wire spot-welded, specimen mounted in epoxy and ground to 2000-grade SiC; mount interface coated with thin silicone sealant, about 1 cm² exposed.
alloy.microstructure: Single austenitic phase after solution treatment; no sigma, chi or Cr2N precipitates found, with N in solid solution. M series has frequent large elongated/elliptical stoichiometric MnS and round/faceted Al2O3 inclusions; MnS sometimes attached to alumina.

test_solution.preparation: Analytical-grade reagents in double-distilled water; purged with purified N2 before and during each potentiodynamic test. Numerical pH is not supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell: specimen working, SCE reference and Pt counter. Immersed at OCP for 2 h to stabilize Ecorr, then raised anodically from 100 mV below Ecorr at 0.2 mV/s. Tests at unquantified room temperature, repeated at least twice; pitting confirmed by optical microscopy afterward. The separate in-situ SPM experiment uses air-saturated 0.1 M KCl and a 1 µm diamond finish; those details do not replace this standard nitrogen-degassed protocol.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Figure 2 arrows explicitly locate pitting potentials, distinguished from preceding metastable-current transients; Figure 4 summarizes the L-series pitting potentials. Pitting was confirmed optically; no fixed numerical current threshold is stated.

experiments.result_note: Approximate manual reading of the Epit arrow, not a threshold inferred from one of the unlabeled current transients. Table 1 explicitly states wt.% and Fe balance. Upper-bound Mn/P entries retain strict < qualifiers (Mn <0.01 where applicable; P <0.001 where applicable). The 1150 °C solution anneal is not electrolyte temperature.
